video_title: I Went 1 on 1 With President Obama | Anthony Edwards

quotes.speaker: Barack Obama
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' potential as a leader and champion
quotes.quote: The thing I love about this guy, you can tell he wants that smoke. He's not backing off. And the best athletes and the best champions, when the pressure is highest, that's when they want the ball, that's when they want the shot, and that's what this guy always does. This young man can go as far as he wants, he's got to keep on working hard, and part of the process when I watch Bird, Magic, Michael, all the great champions, at some point they start figuring out that they can do anything they want on the court. Now they got to figure out how can they get all their other teammates to feed off them. That's where he's about to ascend. So, we'll see how this next playoff works.

quotes.speaker: Barack Obama
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' unique jump shot form and improvement
quotes.quote: He couldn't shoot when I first met him. Boy, he's shooting. He's shooting pretty good now. He's doing better than shooting pretty good. The other thing is, the way he's shooting, there aren't that many guys, maybe Ray Allen, who get up as high on the jump shot. Most of the best shooters, they don't get too far off the ground. But he'll elevate. He'll elevate.
